title: SSC-H01 Wave 02 intake · status, incorporation, checking functions, routing, foreclosure, and remedy

selection_contract.selection_unit: one bounded source-addressable candidate packet joined to one previously zero-execution SSC lane
selection_contract.selection_universe: fourteen declared records spanning source-provided hypothesis, peer-reviewed research, demographics, official oversight removals, appointments, procurement protests, and a judicial correction control
selection_contract.stopping_rule: freeze exactly fourteen sources and eight candidate packets; stop before maintainer review, field-wave execution, conclusion generation, graph effect, or publication

observations.jurisdiction: United States political movement and electorate
observations.protected_center: Movement status narrative and institutions positioned as arbiters of recognition
observations.affected_population_or_institution: MAGA activists and voters; institutions categorized as disrespecting people like them
observations.status_order_claim: Lost honor, declining esteem, institutional disrespect, and restoration of comparative standing are candidate motives.
observations.patriotic_or_security_frame: Make America Great Again supplies a national-restoration frame.
observations.qualified_knower_or_evidence: Ethnography, public-opinion records, electoral demographics, and bounded institutional records; not inference about every voter.
observations.epistemic_reclassification: Institutional criticism may be interpreted as status denial, but no complete material gate is identified.
observations.counterpower_function: Electoral competition, independent research, protected dissent, courts, and review.
observations.counterpower_action: No exact status-restoration policy or correction-routing record is complete.
observations.selector: Movement leaders, campaign institutions, public officials, and audiences.

option_universe.missing: national motive denominator, exact gate, consequence, and practical correction

observations.public_conversion_instrument: Political rhetoric and campaign mobilization require later joins.
observations.public_contribution: Political permission and public authority are candidate conversion surfaces.
observations.counterfactual_foreclosure: Institutions framed as disrespectful may lose standing before a decision.
observations.material_consequence: Status grievance and belonging are observed; exact consequences remain unjoined.
observations.correction_substitution_exit: Open electoral contest and independent research exist; gate-specific effectiveness is unobserved.
observed_facts: The ethnography identifies lost honor, declining esteem, and institutional disrespect among studied activists.
It records belonging, pride, anger, and joy alongside grievance.
observations.working_interpretation: A bounded status-restoration mechanism is supported for the studied population, not a complete electorate or correction chain.
alternative_explanations: ordinary issue preferences and partisan identity
counterevidence: The ethnography is not a national probability sample.
The source-provided synthesis is hypothesis, not empirical proof.

observations.jurisdiction: United States electorate and political coalition
observations.protected_center: Locally distributed comparative-rank claims inside a heterogeneous coalition
observations.affected_population_or_institution: Citizenship, immigration, race, gender, class, religion, employment, and assimilation categories
observations.status_order_claim: The intake tests nested superiority beneath a narrow material elite.
observations.patriotic_or_security_frame: National restoration may provide an umbrella frame, but no phrase is sufficient.
observations.qualified_knower_or_evidence: Hierarchy-attitude research and exact policy or gate records.
observations.epistemic_reclassification: Category hierarchy is a candidate variable, not an institutional fact without a gate and consequence.
observations.counterpower_function: Equal-protection law, voting rights, independent research, and affected-party challenge.
observations.counterpower_action: No complete institutional deservingness rule or consequence is present.
observations.selector: Multiple political and institutional selectors; no common purpose established.

option_universe.known: cross-group association between hierarchy attitudes and political support
option_universe.missing: complete category roster, exact gate, affected rows, consequence, and correction

observations.public_contribution: Political support and later public authority are possible conversion surfaces.
observations.conditional_incorporation: Nested superiority may organize utility, but allocation records are absent.
observations.correction_substitution_exit: Formal electoral and legal routes exist; no gate-specific practical correction is supplied.
observed_facts: Hierarchy-related attitudes are associated with Trump support among Black, Latino, and Asian respondents.
The synthesis proposes locally distributed nested superiority.
observations.working_interpretation: Nested superiority is a candidate mechanism, not a prevalence estimate or hierarchy finding.
alternative_explanations: immigration policy preference not reducible to superiority
counterevidence: Associations do not establish every respondent’s motive.
No complete selector or consequence denominator is present.

observations.protected_center: Political coalition whose demographic diversity may coexist with unequal status preferences
observations.affected_population_or_institution: White, Hispanic, Black, Asian, and other-race voters
observations.status_order_claim: The record tests conditional multiracial incorporation rather than racial purity or automatic egalitarianism.
observations.patriotic_or_security_frame: National restoration is a coalition frame, not an individual-motive identifier.
observations.qualified_knower_or_evidence: Electoral composition, attitude research, and institutional-order frameworks.
observations.epistemic_reclassification: Non-White support is genuine political agency, not proof of neutrality, tokenism, or secret identity.
observations.counterpower_function: Elections, civil-rights law, independent organization, and collective claims.
observations.counterpower_action: No complete governance, authority, burden, outcome, or remedy record exists for the coalition as a whole.
observations.selector: Voters, parties, movement organizations, officials, and institutions.

option_universe.known: substantial non-White participation and cross-group hierarchy attitudes
option_universe.missing: complete motives, governing authority, outputs, affected populations, and remedies

observations.public_conversion_instrument: Election and appointment processes may convert coalition support into authority.
observations.public_contribution: Electoral authority is public; later conversion needs separate packets.
observations.conditional_incorporation: Independent authority versus selector legitimation remains unresolved.
observations.counterfactual_foreclosure: Coalition diversity can complicate opposition, but foreclosure is not established.
observations.material_consequence: Demographic composition is observed; material distribution is not.
observations.correction_substitution_exit: Elections and organization remain available; effectiveness is unobserved.
observed_facts: Pew reports 78 percent non-Hispanic White and about one-fifth non-White in Trump’s coalition.
Research finds hierarchy-related attitudes associated with non-White Trump support.
Racial-order scholarship supports institutional analysis without identical explicit beliefs.
observations.working_interpretation: The record supports a heterogeneous coalition with limited overlap; it does not establish a complete racial order.
counterevidence: Composition cannot identify individual motive or authority.
Non-White participation proves neither neutrality nor tokenism.
Framework is vocabulary, not a case finding.

observations.jurisdiction: United States institutions and political representation
observations.protected_center: Institutions using demographic presence as evidence about legitimacy or neutrality
observations.affected_population_or_institution: Represented officials and members; lower-status or excluded populations
observations.status_order_claim: Visible diversity may be offered as proof that a selector is neutral or patterned exclusion is excuse-making.
observations.qualified_knower_or_evidence: Complete roster, role authority, veto and budget power, outcomes, evidence access, and remedies.
observations.epistemic_reclassification: Presence is separated from justice; represented people are not presumed powerless, tokenized, neutral, or egalitarian.
observations.counterpower_function: Independent collective organization, transparency, judicial review, and binding checks.
observations.counterpower_action: No specific institution supplies the complete role-power-outcome-remedy denominator.

option_universe.known: scholarship distinguishes racial presence from racial justice
option_universe.missing: specific institution, roster, authority, selection history, outcomes, burdens, and correction

observations.public_contribution: Representation and public authority require a case-specific join.
observations.conditional_incorporation: Selected presence may legitimate a selector, but this intake classifies no person as a token.
observations.counterfactual_foreclosure: Presence-as-neutrality is a candidate mechanism; no bounded foreclosure is retained.
observations.correction_substitution_exit: Practical correction cannot be evaluated without the missing packet.
observed_facts: Scholarship treats a racially diverse elite as politically indeterminate without authority and outcome evidence.
Racial-order scholarship supplies an institutional framework.
The source synthesis identifies representation-as-neutrality-proof as a mechanism to test.
observations.working_interpretation: The discriminator is valid, but no source-complete institution is present.
alternative_explanations: diversity is descriptive rather than a neutrality claim
counterevidence: The scholarship does not establish that any represented person lacks authority.
No complete institution-specific denominator is present.

observations.protected_center: Executive removal authority over inspectors general and continuity of independent oversight
observations.affected_population_or_institution: Inspectors general, offices, audits, investigations, Congress, agencies, employees, contractors, and beneficiaries
observations.status_order_claim: Independent oversight functions may be treated as removable personnel rather than durable checking institutions.
observations.qualified_knower_or_evidence: Official removal communication, statutory rules, project inventories, Congress, courts, and inspectors general.
observations.epistemic_reclassification: Official action is separated from inferred motive; procedural and checking consequences remain testable.
observations.counterpower_function: Advance notice, rationale, handoff reports, congressional assessment, and litigation.
observations.counterpower_action: Broad terminations are recorded; CRS says notice and waiting requirements did not appear to be followed.
observations.selector: President and executive branch; Congress and courts retain checking roles.

option_universe.known: sixteen named offices and statutory notice/handoff procedures
option_universe.missing: project inventory, continuity, final legal resolution, replacements, outcomes, and practical correction

observations.public_contribution: Executive removal authority and control over oversight succession.
observations.material_consequence: Immediate removal can interrupt continuity before congressional assessment.
observations.correction_substitution_exit: Formal notice, handoff, acting officials, and litigation exist; effectiveness remains incomplete.
observed_facts: The House communication identifies sixteen affected departments, agencies, and offices.
CRS describes independence, notice, rationale, and handoff protections.
CRS says the action did not appear to follow notice and waiting requirements.
observations.working_interpretation: A bounded checking-function removal mechanism is present; motive, final legality, and downstream consequences remain unresolved.
counterevidence: CRS is not a final judicial judgment.
The record does not show every audit outcome.
Removal authority remains subject to disputed procedures.

observations.jurisdiction: United States science and technology policy
observations.protected_center: OSTP leadership and federal science-and-technology agenda setting
observations.affected_population_or_institution: Federal agencies, researchers, technology companies, workers, beneficiaries, and alternative participants
observations.patriotic_or_security_frame: Critical-technology leadership and a Golden Age of American Innovation are explicit frames.
observations.qualified_knower_or_evidence: Confirmation record, directives, participant and conflict records, prior-role chronology, decision memoranda, alternatives, and outcomes.
observations.epistemic_reclassification: A public role and agenda are observed; vocabulary similarity is not carried influence.
observations.counterpower_function: Senate confirmation, ethics processes, public comments, agency review, Congress, courts, and scientific scrutiny.
observations.counterpower_action: Confirmation and priorities establish a decision surface; no source-complete translation event is retained.
observations.selector: President, Senate, OSTP Director, OSTP, and agencies.

option_universe.known: confirmed office, vote, public goals, and policy surface
option_universe.missing: prior private role in this packet, carried object, participants, conflicts, alternatives, implementation, and consequence

observations.public_conversion_instrument: Senate confirmation and presidential direction to OSTP.
observations.counterfactual_foreclosure: Prior employment or shared vocabulary could be overread as causation.
observations.material_consequence: Public office and policy surface are established; private-to-public translation is not.
observations.correction_substitution_exit: Formal confirmation exists; no affected-party correction chain is tested.
observed_facts: The Senate confirmed Michael Kratsios by 74-25.
The White House identified three OSTP goals.
No retained source identifies a private artifact or relationship as the cause of a bounded public decision.
observations.working_interpretation: The lane retains a bounded non-link: public role and agenda are established; personnel-routing causation is not.
counterevidence: Prior employment is absent from the retained official records.
Shared vocabulary is not causation.
No complete consequence denominator is present.

observations.protected_center: Army DCGS-A architecture, solicitation, evaluation, and protest process
observations.affected_population_or_institution: Commercial and traditional integrators, rejected offerors, Army users, taxpayers, and alternative architectures
observations.patriotic_or_security_frame: Operational intelligence requirements provide a national-security frame.
observations.qualified_knower_or_evidence: Solicitations, market research, bidder denominator, criteria, demonstrations, protest records, support allocation, performance, users, and necessity claims.
observations.epistemic_reclassification: Denied protests are review outcomes, not proof that the option set was complete or winners intrinsically superior.
observations.counterpower_function: GAO protest, courts, congressional oversight, recompete, modular substitution, and operational evaluation.
observations.counterpower_action: GAO reviewed and denied Palantir’s solicitation challenge and General Dynamics’ evaluation challenge.
observations.selector: Army contracting and program offices; GAO provides external review.

option_universe.known: Palantir challenge, Army market research, General Dynamics rejection, evaluation protest, and intervenors
option_universe.missing: complete bidders, comparable data/testing, support, performance, excluded architectures, necessity claims, substitution, and recovery

observations.public_conversion_instrument: Army solicitations, evaluations, and GAO decisions.
observations.public_contribution: Public procurement, testing, evaluation, and mission validation.
observations.private_capacity_or_right: Selected firms may gain contracts, data, integration position, and performance evidence.
observations.counterfactual_foreclosure: Alternatives and review are visible, but later support asymmetry and foreclosure remain unresolved.
observations.material_consequence: Two protest records establish competition and review; later option-set formation remains unresolved.
observations.correction_substitution_exit: GAO review worked procedurally; substitution, exit, and recovery remain untested.
observed_facts: Palantir challenged commercial-item treatment and GAO denied the protest.
General Dynamics challenged rejection and GAO denied the protest.
The records identify multiple competitors and intervenors.
observations.working_interpretation: The records defeat a target-only story but do not resolve counterfactual foreclosure.
counterevidence: Both protests were denied after record review.
No complete later option universe or support history is supplied.
Competition and protest access cut against total foreclosure.

observations.protected_center: Federal judicial evidentiary standard under Title VII
observations.affected_population_or_institution: Majority-group and minority-group Title VII plaintiffs and lower courts
observations.status_order_claim: The Court rejected a group-specific heightened burden; no broader status order is assigned.
observations.qualified_knower_or_evidence: Statutory text, parties, lower-court record, Supreme Court opinion, docket, and merits proceedings on remand.
observations.epistemic_reclassification: The unequal evidentiary rule was legally corrected without converting correction into a merits finding.
observations.counterpower_function: Independent judiciary with authority to grant review, vacate, remand, and issue judgment.
observations.counterpower_action: The Court unanimously vacated and remanded; the docket records the sequence.

option_universe.known: parties, question, opinion, judgment, vacatur, and remand
option_universe.missing: final merits result and system-wide remedy effectiveness

observations.conditional_incorporation: The rule applies without using majority or minority status as an automatic merits outcome.
observations.material_consequence: The lower-court rule was removed before final merits adjudication.
observations.correction_substitution_exit: Evidence access, burden correction, vacatur, and remand worked; merits remain open.
observed_facts: The unanimous Court rejected the background-circumstances rule.
The judgment was vacated and remanded.
The Court did not decide whether Ames was discriminated against.
observations.working_interpretation: A bounded positive counterpower control: one correction route worked at one stage, not generally.
alternative_explanations: later merits proceedings may deny relief
counterevidence: The Court did not decide the discrimination claim.
The case does not validate categorical anti-DEI enforcement.
One correction cannot establish system-wide remedy availability.
